issue_context.title: Yale Smart Alarm - Authentication Failure
issue_context.body:
### The problem

I have been seeing this issue on an off for a couple of months, but it is now happening daily.
After a reboot it will be working for upto 12 hours sometimes 24hrs, then the error will occur. It then constantly displays it is in armed mode and it can't be updated. Rebooting resolves the issue. 

Totally unrelated (maybe) I also see the same issue with the Withings integration dropping but the difference is that the functionality still works.



### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

2021.12.8

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

Yale Smart Alarm

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/yale_smart_alarm

### Example YAML snippet

_No response_

### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

```txt
Logger: homeassistant.components.yale_smart_alarm
Source: helpers/update_coordinator.py:227
Integration: Yale Smart Living (documentation, issues)
First occurred: 4:20:14 AM (1 occurrences)
Last logged: 4:20:14 AM

Authentication failed while fetching yale_smart_alarm data:
```


### Additional information

_No response_
